headline: No registered workflow produces what you asked for, so none is offered.
points: Understood: "a heavier weight on the PPI term in the loss"

unavailable.label: “a TF activity matrix”
unavailable.reason: PANDA does not give it: the PPI network is an input of possible TF cooperation. PANDA refines a cooperativity matrix internally, but the executor does not save it, and it is not a measurement of physical complexes or stoichiometry.

unavailable.label: “a learning rate of 1e-4”
unavailable.reason: NetZoo runs GIRAFFE with its package defaults and passes no settings to it, so "a learning rate of 1e-4" cannot be applied.
